notes: Easy (7/30). Recover the content of an unlinked-but-open file descriptor: scan /proc/*/fd for links ending in '(deleted)', read behind each descriptor, and select the payload whose first line is exactly SHARD_ID=<id>. Hidden states spawn several simultaneous keepers holding decoy payloads — one that mentions the requested id on a non-marker line and one whose marker id merely has the requested id as a prefix — plus a negative query that must exit 2, so a substring or wrong-fd read fails. Single-stage, single tool surface (procfs); no dependency chain or resource pressure.
